Class GemCollection

java.lang.Object
splendor.valueobjects.GemCollection
public class GemCollection extends Object
This represents a collection of gems and their quantities. stores the no of gems for each color

    • isEmptyWithoutJoker

      public boolean isEmptyWithoutJoker()
      Checks whether this gem collection contains no non-joker gems. Gold jokers are ignored in this check.
      Returns:
      true if all non-joker gem counts are 0, otherwise false

    • contains

      public boolean contains(GemCollection other)
      Checks whether this collection contains at least as many gems as another collection for every gem color in the other collection.
      Parameters:
      other - the gem collection to compare against

      true if this collection contains all required gems, otherwise false

    • containsAfterJoker

      public boolean containsAfterJoker(GemCollection other)
      Checks whether this collection can satisfy another collection's required gems when gold jokers may be used to cover any shortage.
      Parameters:
      other - the gem collection representing the required gems
      Returns:
      true if this collection can satisfy the requirement using jokers if needed, otherwise false
